description: This Java source file defines a REST API endpoint class for managing Employee data via HTTP requests using Spring Framework annotations. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting Employee entities, along with error handling for invalid or placeholder path variables.

classes.name: EmployeeRestEndpoint
classes.description: REST controller class handling HTTP requests related to Employee entities, including retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and special error handling for path placeholders.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Handles GET requests for fetching a specific employee by numeric ID.

methods.name: rejectLiteralEmployeeId
methods.description: Handles GET requests where the path contains a literal placeholder instead of a numeric ID and responds with a 400 error.

methods.name: getEmployeeFallback
methods.description: Fallback method handling non-numeric path segments, attempting to parse as ID or returning errors if invalid.

methods.name: listEmployeesForPreview
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of sample employee items for preview or testing purposes.

methods.name: createEmployee
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new employee based on provided resource data.

methods.name: updateExistingEmployee
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing employee.

methods.name: deleteExistingEmployee
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an employee by ID.

methods.name: safe
methods.description: Utility method to escape special characters in strings for JSON safety.

methods.name: isPlaceholder
methods.description: Utility method detecting if a path segment is a placeholder pattern or URL-encoded placeholder.
